correctness.rationale: Weighted adjacency B=J sum_j translation by e_j + K translation by all-ones is diagonal in Walsh characters χ_S, with λ_k=J(d−2k)+K(−1)^k. For fixed parity, λ_k drops by 4J as k rises by 2, so the only minimum candidates are k=d and k=d−1; comparing gives η=(−1)^d K/J and threshold η=1. Rayleigh lower bound Nλ_min/2 is attained by an actual Boolean character, giving the exact energy for all J>0, real K, d≥2. At equality a Boolean spin after multiplying by χ_D is affine a0+sum_j a_j z_j; f(z)^2=1 forces a0 a_j=0 and a_i a_j=0 for all i≠j, hence exactly one coefficient ±1. This rules out all other minimizers, giving 2,2(d+1),2d states. Averaging character products over the appropriate r mismatching coordinates gives the three Hamming correlation laws. Independent full enumeration of all 2^(2^d) spin states for d=2,3,4 at K/J∈{−3,−1,0,1,3} verified exact energy/minimizers/correlations. These checks corroborate the all-dimensional proof.
residual_risks: Classical finite-size zero-temperature result only: no bulk finite-T phase transition, finite-temperature correlations or disorder stability.
The two-domain pattern itself is known from differently weighted multi-shell hypercube models.
